test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Choose the correctly spelled scientific word.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 3**, i.e., **Vaccine**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**Vaccine**" refers to a substance used to stimulate the production of antibodies and provide immunity against diseases.
 
• The correct spelling is "**Vaccine**", as derived from the Latin word "*vacca*" meaning "cow".
